units: Snh. 46ᵇ אחד קושר … מצות ת׳ one ties (the body of the stoned culprit to the pole), and one unties, in order to comply formally with the command of hanging (Deut. XXI, 22).—2) suspense, doubt.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 6:1:11">Y. Yoma VI, 43ᶜ</cite> top <he>ועשהו חטאת קבעו בת׳ שלא יידחה</he> ‘and shall make it a sin-offering’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 16:9">Lev. XVI, 9</cite>), the text declares it a sin-offering even during the suspense, so that it cannot be removed from its designation (by a subsequent event); <he>קבעו בת׳ שיזדווג וכ׳</he> the text puts it in suspense (makes its designation dependent on a condition), that it be matched with its fellow (and it loses its sacred character if the fellow goat is unavailable). Y. Ḥag. I, end, 76ᵈ <he>אם באת … לתלות ואם לשרוף … יותר מן הת׳</he> if a case (of T’rumah) comes before thee, and thou dost not know whether to declare it doubtful (<cite ref="V00578"><he>תָּלוּי</he></cite>) or to condemn it to be burnt, be rather inclined to condemn than to declare doubtful; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:2:2">Y. Sot. VIII, beg. 22ᵇ</cite>
